comparison.objective: Unload five blocks from an intermittently rotating carousel before they return to the loading arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed interception, grasping, crating, and collision avoidance around another arm.
comparison.success_condition: Fraction of five cubes crated; any arm contact scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests cycle-time material handling in a shared workspace, not adjustment of a locked mechanism or measured impact response.
